english.title: Make misleading statement in supply of financial statement re parental compensation order - Crime and Disorder
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in providing a statement of your financial circumstances in connection with a parental compensation order under section 13B(4) of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998,

(A)_[made a statement which you knew to be false in a material particular or recklessly provided a statement which was false in a material particular namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE STATEMENT..)]_
(B)_[knowingly failed to disclose a material fact, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FACT..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13B(4) and (6) of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998

english.notes:
(i) This offence was inserted by paragraph 2 of Schedule 10 to the Serious Organised Crime and Police Act 2005.
(ii) See also Statement of Facts.
(iii) Section 13B(7) of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998 provides that in proceedings in respect of this offence may, despite anything in section 127(1) of the 1980 Act (limitation of time), be commenced at any time within two years from the date of the commission of the offence or within six months of its first discovery by the local authority, whichever period expires earlier.
